name: Aboleth
regionalEffects: The region containing an aboleth's lair is warped by it, creating the following effects:

items.name: Foul Water
entries: Water sources within 1 mile of the lair are supernaturally fouled. Creatures other than the aboleth and its allies that drink such water must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.

items.name: Psionic Projection
entries: While in its lair, the aboleth can cast {@spell Project Image|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}). When casting the spell this way, the spell's range is 1 mile, and the aboleth can use its telepathy as if it were in the illusion's space.

regionalEffects: If the aboleth dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Ankhtepot
regionalEffects: Har'Akir is altered by Ankhtepot's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Blistering Sun
items.entry: Any outdoor area of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in Har'Akir is an area of {@hazard extreme heat|XDMG} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}).

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Ankhtepot can close or open the borders to Har'Akir at will. While the borders are closed, whirling sands fill the Mists surrounding Har'Akir. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage.

items.name: Control Undead
items.entry: Undead of CR 5 or lower in Har'Akir have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition and obey Ankhtepot's orders.

regionalEffects: If Ankhtepot dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Arch-hag
regionalEffects: The region containing an arch-hag's lair is altered by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Lapsus Linguae
entries: Creatures (excluding the hag and its allies) within 1 mile of the lair subtract {@dice 1d10} from any ability check they make when they take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action.

items.name: Meddlesome Magic
entries: Whenever a creature other than the hag or its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while within 1 mile of the lair, the next time that creature casts a spell using a spell slot, it also casts {@spell Confusion|XPHB} centered on itself. The spell uses the creature's spellcasting ability and doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

regionalEffects: If the arch-hag is destroyed or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Azalin Rex
regionalEffects: Darkon is altered by Azalin's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Azalin can close or open the borders to Darkon at will. While the borders are closed, undead terrors fill the Mists surrounding Darkon. Whenever a creature enters the Mists, one {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} {@creature Zombie Clot|RHW} appears in a random unoccupied space within 30 feet of that creature.

items.name: Lord of the Dead
items.entry: While in his domain, Azalin can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as his Spellcasting action. When Azalin casts this spell in this way, he can place the sensor in any Undead in Darkon with an Intelligence of 6 or less, even if it is beyond 1 mile of Azalin. In addition, Azalin can speak through the Undead he placed the sensor in.

items.name: No Secrets
items.entry: Whenever a creature in Darkon casts a spell using a level 5+ spell slot, Azalin becomes aware of that creature's name and location. A {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} spell blocks this effect.

regionalEffects: If Azalin dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Beholder
regionalEffects: The region containing a beholder's lair is twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Scopophobia
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of the lair feel as if they're being watched. Any creature (excluding the beholder and its allies) that finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} while within 1 mile of the lair must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from that rest.

items.name: Warping Terrain
entries: Minor warps in reality occur near the lair; any creature (excluding the beholder) within 1 mile of the lair that makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and rolls a 1 has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

regionalEffects: If the beholder dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Black Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient black dragon's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Acrid Haze
entries: Odorous and stifling fog covers the area within 1 mile of the lair, rendering that area {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. Travel for creatures other than the dragon and its allies takes twice the usual time in that area.

items.name: Foul Water
entries: Water sources within 1 mile of the lair are supernaturally fouled. A creature that drinks such water must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Blue Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient blue dragon's lair is changed by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Sinkholes
entries: Sinkholes form more frequently in the area within 1 mile of the lair. Whenever a creature in that area other than the dragon and its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, a sinkhole opens beneath the creature, and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@dice 2d4 × 10} feet into the sinkhole.

items.name: Spiteful Storms
entries: Dust devils and thunderstorms rage within 1 mile of the lair. The area is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Brass Dragon
regionalEffects: The area containing an adult or ancient brass dragon's lair is altered by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Mirages
entries: While in its lair, the dragon can cast {@spell Major Image|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action. When casting the spell this way, the spell's range is 1 mile, and the dragon doesn't need to see the spot where the illusion appears.

items.name: Refreshing Water
entries: Water within 1 mile of the lair is magically refreshing. A creature that drinks such water gains {@dice 2d4} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and the dragon is immediately aware of the creature's presence.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Bronze Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient bronze dragon's lair is changed by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Buoying Currents
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of the lair that lack a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} ignore the extra cost of movement while swimming.

items.name: Sun and Storms
entries: While in its lair, the dragon can cast {@spell Control Weather|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action. When casting the spell this way, the dragon can control the weather within 1 mile of its lair, regardless if the dragon is inside or outside.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Chakuna
regionalEffects: Valachan is altered by Chakuna's presence, creating the following effects.

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in her domain, Chakuna can close or open the borders to Valachan at will. While the borders are closed, shadowy beasts skulk or soar amid the Mists surrounding Valachan. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 1d10} Piercing damage.

items.name: Heightened Senses
items.entry: Beasts and Monstrosities have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom checks.

items.name: Whispering Shadows
items.entry: Humanoids subtract {@dice 1d8} from any ability checks they make when they take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

regionalEffects: If Chakuna dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Copper Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient copper dragon's lair is changed by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Chatty Critters
entries: Tiny Beasts magically gain the ability to speak and understand Draconic while within 6 miles of the lair.

items.name: Giggle Fits
entries: Whenever a creature other than the dragon and its allies is within 1 mile of the lair and rolls a 1 on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, as it is wracked with laughter.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Cthulhu
regionalEffects: Innsmouth is altered by Cthulhu's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Choking Depths
items.entry: A creature can {@hazard Suffocation|XPHB|hold its breath} for only 30 seconds while in the domain.

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in its domain, Cthulhu can close or open the borders of Innsmouth at will. While the borders are closed, those who enter the Mists surrounding Innsmouth become lost at sea amid inky fog for {@dice 3d4} days before arriving once more at Innsmouth.

items.name: Something in the Air
items.entry: Creatures other than Cthulhu and its allies have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

regionalEffects: If Cthulhu dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Death Tyrant
regionalEffects: The region containing a death tyrant's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Negative Energy Suffusion
entries: Whenever a creature within 1 mile of the lair regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from a spell, it subtracts {@dice 1d10} from the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} regained.

items.name: Scopophobia
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of the lair feel as if they're being watched. Any creature (excluding the death tyrant and its allies) that finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} while within 1 mile of the lair must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from that rest.

regionalEffects: If the death tyrant dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Demilich
regionalEffects: The region containing a demilich's lair is twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Enervating Domain
entries: Whenever a creature other than the demilich or one of its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} within 1 mile of the lair, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum reduced by {@dice 1d4}. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} outside that area.

items.name: Travel Ward
entries: Creatures can't use teleportation or planar travel to enter or exit the lair.

regionalEffects: If the demilich dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Dracolich
regionalEffects: The region containing a dracolich's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Sapping Mist
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by pale fog. Whenever a creature other than the dracolich or one of its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in that area, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

items.name: Soul Drain
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of the lair have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

regionalEffects: If the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately. The effects resume if the dracolich gains a new body (see its Soul Gem trait).

name: Ebonbane
regionalEffects: The Shadowlands is altered by {@i Ebonbane}'s presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in its domain, Ebonbane can close or open the borders of the Shadowlands at will. While the borders are closed, whirling blades of magic fly through the Mists surrounding the Shadowlands. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d10} Force damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

items.name: Haunted Woods
items.entry: The forest within 1 mile of Ebonbane's lair is wreathed in a powerful illusion. Whenever a creature other than Ebonbane or the sword's allies finishes a Short or Long Rest in that area, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw, or it is lost in the forest, always finding itself at the location it started in until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

items.name: Turning Weapons
items.entry: While in its lair, Ebonbane can transform nonmagical {@item Greatsword|XPHB|Greatswords} and {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords} within 1 mile of the lair into {@creature Animated Flying Sword|XMM|Animated Flying Swords} by completing a 24-hour ritual.

regionalEffects: If {@i Ebonbane} is destroyed, these effects end immediately.

name: Gold Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient gold dragon's lair is altered by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Dream Messenger
entries: While in its lair, the dragon can cast {@spell Dream|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. When casting the spell this way, the dragon can target any creature within 6 miles.

items.name: Foretelling Fog
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by opalescent fog. While in that area, creatures can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}, as the fog swirls into shapes that warn of danger.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Green Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient green dragon's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Beast Spies
entries: Tiny Beasts magically gain the ability to understand Draconic and can communicate telepathically with the dragon while within 1 mile of the lair.

items.name: Poisonous Thicket
entries: Ordinary plants growing within 1 mile of the lair poison the air around them. Whenever a creature other than the dragon or its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in that area, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Harkon Lukas
regionalEffects: Kartakass is altered by Harkon's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Beast Spies
items.entry: From dawn until dusk, Tiny Beasts in the domain magically gain the ability to understand Common and can communicate telepathically with other Beasts and Monstrosities.

items.name: Children of the Night
items.entry: Harkon exerts influence over the animals of his domain. From dusk until dawn, Medium or smaller Beasts within 1 miles of Harkon have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition. If Harkon pleases, these animals become {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to creatures other than Harkon and his allies.

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Harkon can close or open the borders to Kartakass at will. While the borders are closed, a strange melody fills the Mists surrounding Kartakass. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in them must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, or it has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for {@dice 1d6} hours, then awakes within sight of the town of Harmonia in Kartakass. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

regionalEffects: If Harkon dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Hazlik
regionalEffects: Hazlan is altered by Hazlik's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Hazlik can close or open the borders to Hazlan at will. While the borders are closed, the Mists surrounding Hazlan are filled with monstrous magical experiments. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) Force damage and have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

items.name: Frayed Magic
items.entry: Whenever a creature (excluding Hazlik and his allies) casts a spell using a level 5+ spell slot, it rolls on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|XPHB|Wild Magic Surge table} in the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} to create a magical effect.

items.name: Magic Nightmares
items.entry: While in his lair, Veneficus, Hazlik can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as his Spellcasting action. When the spell is cast this way, its range is all of Hazlan, Hazlik can see but can't hear through the sensor, and the sensor can appear only on an Eye of Hazlik.

regionalEffects: If Hazlik dies, these effects end immediately. The effects resume if Hazlik gains a new body (see his Darklord Restoration trait).

name: Ivana Boritsi and Ivan Boritsi
regionalEffects: Borca is altered by Ivana's and Ivan's presences, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in their domain, Ivana or Ivan can close or open the borders to Borca at will. While the borders are closed, the Mists surrounding Borca are filled with briar vines (Ivana) or barbed wire (Ivan). The Mists become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and whenever a creature moves into or within the Mists, it takes {@damage 2d4} Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels. Once Ivana or Ivan closes or opens the borders, neither Darklord can do so again until the next dawn.

items.name: Ivana's Whispers (Ivana Only)
items.entry: Ivana can encode a message of 25 words or fewer into flowers in Borca at dawn. Until the next dawn, the first time a creature smells a flower, it hears the message in its mind, understanding the meaning of the message.

items.name: Mystery Letters (Ivan Only)
items.entry: Whenever Ivan writes a letter and addresses it to a creature in Borca whose name he knows and that he's seen before, the letter appears near that creature at the next dawn. The letter appears in an unobserved but obvious space, such as a bedside table or among gear.

items.name: Spies
items.entry: While in Borca, Ivana and Ivan can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. To cast the spell, there must be a Large or bigger plant (Ivana) or a Tiny doll or similar toy (Ivan) within range from which the sensor appears.

regionalEffects: If a Darklord of Borca dies, that Darklord's effects end immediately. Those effects resume if that Darklord gains a new body (see {@creature Ivana Boritsi|RHW|Ivana's} and {@creature Ivan Dilisnya|RHW|Ivan's} Darklord Restoration traits).

name: Kraken
regionalEffects: The region containing a kraken's lair is twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Ocean Tyrant
entries: The kraken exerts its dominance over animals in its domain. All Beasts within 1 mile of the lair have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition while in that area.

items.name: Sea and Storms
entries: While in its lair, the kraken can cast {@spell Control Weather|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

regionalEffects: If the kraken dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Lich
regionalEffects: The region containing a lich's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: All-Seeing
entries: While in its lair, the lich can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action.

items.name: Inevitable Siphon
entries: Whenever a Humanoid dies within 1 mile of the lair, its soul is immediately consumed by the lich. A Humanoid whose soul is consumed in this way can be brought back to life only by a True Resurrection or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

regionalEffects: If the lich is destroyed or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately. These effects resume if the lich gains a new body (see its Spirit Jar trait).

name: Lord Soth of Sithicus
regionalEffects: Sithicus is altered by Lord Soth's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Lord Soth can close or open the borders to Sithicus. While the borders are closed, purple flames fill the Mists surrounding Sithicus. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) Fire damage plus 5 ({@dice 1d10}) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Fearless Soldiers
items.entry: Undead allies of Lord Soth have Immunity to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Guilt of Sithicus
items.entry: Few sleep soundly in Sithicus. Whenever a creature other than Lord Soth and his allies finishes a Long Rest in the domain, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

regionalEffects: If Lord Soth dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Mother Lorinda
regionalEffects: Tepest is altered by Lorinda's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in her domain, Mother Lorinda can close or open the borders to Tepest at will. While the borders are closed, a violent storm fills the Mists surrounding Tepest. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take {@damage 2d8} Lightning damage and be pushed up to 30 feet straight toward Tepest. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

items.name: Mother's Watchers
items.entry: Creatures that have sacrificed an eye to Mother can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and pray to her. When they do so, Lorinda can perceive through the creature's senses as well as her own until the end of the creature's next turn. When perceiving through a creature's senses, Lorinda benefits from any special senses it has.

items.name: Sun and Storms
items.entry: While in Tepest, Lorinda can cast {@spell Control Weather|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. When casting the spell this way, Lorinda can control the weather within 5 miles of herself, regardless of whether she is inside or outside.

regionalEffects: If Lorinda dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Mummy Lord
regionalEffects: The region containing a mummy lord's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Cursed Fate
entries: Whenever a creature other than the mummy or one of its allies casts a Divination spell while within 1 mile of the lair, the creature makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast the spell is wasted, but any resources used to cast it aren't expended.

items.name: Soul Drain
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of the lair have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

regionalEffects: If the mummy lord is destroyed or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately. The effects resume if the mummy lord gains a new body (see its Undead Restoration trait).

name: Murgaxor
lairActions: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Murgaxor can take one of the following lair actions; after he does so, he can't use that action again until he finishes a long rest:

items.name: Clay Behemoth
items.entry: A {@creature clay golem} erupts from the floor in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of the ritual circle. The golem obeys Murgaxor's commands, takes its turns on initiative count 10 (losing initiative ties), fights until destroyed, and reverts to a mound of inanimate clay after 1 hour.

items.name: Earthen Fist
items.entry: A medium fist of packed earth rises from the floor in an unoccupied space that Murgaxor can see within 30 feet of him. The fist attacks when one creature of his choice is within 4 feet of the fist. The fist has a {@hit 11} bonus to hit, and on a hit, the target takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and is grappled (escape {@dc 15}). The fist disappears if the attack roll misses or if the grapple ends. When the fist disappears, this lair action recharges, allowing Murgaxor to use it again.

items.name: Necrotic Burst
items.entry: Tendrils of necrotic energy erupt from the ritual circle and lash out at any number of creatures Murgaxor can see within 15 feet of the circle. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, or it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Summon Mephits
items.entry: Murgaxor summons four {@creature mud mephit||mud mephits} that appear in unoccupied spaces within 15 feet of the ritual circle. The mephits obey Murgaxor's commands, take their turns on initiative count 15 (losing initiative ties), and fight until destroyed.

name: Red Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient red dragon's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Burning Heat
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is an area of extreme heat. A burning creature or object takes an additional {@damage 1d4} Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Smoldering Haze
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} with clouds of ash. Whenever a creature other than the dragon or one of its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in that area, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Saidra d'Honaire
regionalEffects: Dementlieu is altered by Saidra's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in her domain, Saidra can close or open the borders to Dementlieu at will. While the borders are closed, the countryside called Chateaufaux appears in the Mists surrounding Dementlieu. Creatures in the Mists get lost amid mazelike hedgerows and fogbanks, only to reappear on the outskirts of Port-a-Lucine {@dice 2d6} hours later.

items.name: Empowered Actors
items.entry: Humanoids add {@dice 1d8} to Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB} or {@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks made while wearing a mask.

items.name: Invitation
items.entry: At dawn, Saidra can choose a creature whose name she knows or that she's seen before. A simple mask and an invitation to the next Grand Masquerade appear to that creature. The letter and mask appear in an unobserved but obvious space, such as a bedside table or among gear.

regionalEffects: If {@creature Saidra d'Honaire|RHW|Saidra} dies, these effects end immediately. The effects resume if Saidra gains a new body (see her Darklord Restoration trait).

name: Shadow Dragon
regionalEffects: The region around a shadow dragon's lair is twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Negative Energy Suffusion
entries: Whenever a creature within 1 mile of the lair regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from a spell, it subtracts {@dice 1d10} from the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} regained.

items.name: Stifling Shadows
entries: Within 1 mile of the lair, effects that normally create {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} instead create {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}, and creatures there have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Silver Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient silver dragon's lair is changed by its magic, creating the following effects:

items.name: Gentle Gusts
entries: Winds buoy creatures that fall within 1 mile of the lair. Such creatures descend at a rate of 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

items.name: Sun and Storms
entries: While in its lair, the dragon can cast {@spell Control Weather|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Sphinx
regionalEffects: The region containing a sphinx of lore's or sphinx of valor's lair is altered by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Distant Sight
entries: While in its lair, the sphinx can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action. When cast this way, the spell's range is 1 mile.

items.name: Infusion of Knowledge
entries: Whenever the sphinx or one of its allies takes a {@action Study|XPHB} action while within 1 mile of the lair, it adds {@dice 1d6} to any ability check it makes for that action.

regionalEffects: If the sphinx dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Star Spawn Emissary
regionalEffects: The region containing a star spawn emissary's lair becomes twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Cosmic Transformation
entries: When a creature in the lair shape-shifts to its true form, creatures in a 10- foot Emanation originating from the shape-shifter take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) Force damage.

items.name: Terrifying Topography
entries: Terrain in the lair is transformed into a mockery of flesh with unsettling features like thick veins, lolling tongues, and pulsating orifices. Creatures of the emissary's choice within 1 mile of the lair have Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition while in that area.

regionalEffects: If the star spawn emissary dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Strahd von Zarovich
regionalEffects: Barovia is altered by Strahd's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Strahd can close or open the borders to Barovia at will. While the borders are closed, noxious fog suffuses the Mists surrounding Barovia. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

items.name: Dreadful Darkness
items.entry: While in an area of {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, creatures other than Strahd and creatures of his choice have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to end or avoid the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Jealous Heart
items.entry: When a character receives {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} but already has it, that character can't give it to another character in the group.

regionalEffects: If Strahd dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Unicorn
regionalEffects: The region containing a unicorn's lair is changed by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Obscuring Foliage
entries: The unicorn and its allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks while within 1 mile of the lair.

items.name: Positive Energy
entries: Whenever a creature within 1 mile of the lair regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from a spell, it regains the maximum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} possible. Additionally, the effects of curses are suppressed within 1 mile of the lair.

regionalEffects: If the unicorn dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Vampire
regionalEffects: The region containing a vampire's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Children of the Night
entries: The vampire exerts influence over the animals in its domain. From dusk until dawn, Medium or smaller Beasts have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition while within 1 mile of the lair.

items.name: Looming Shadows
entries: Shadows within 1 mile of the lair seem to move as if alive. Any creature (excluding the vampire and its allies) that finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} while within 1 mile of the lair must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from that rest.

items.name: Mists
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by a persistent, creeping fog. The vampire and any creatures of its choice are unaffected by the fog.

regionalEffects: If the vampire dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Viktra Mordenheim
regionalEffects: Lamordia is altered by Viktra's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Air of Obsession
items.entry: When a creature fails a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}, that creature takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) Psychic damage.

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in her domain, Viktra can close or open the borders to Lamordia. While the borders are closed, lightning storms roll through the Mists surrounding Lamordia. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Lightning damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

regionalEffects: If Viktra dies, these effects end immediately.

name: Vladeska Drakov
regionalEffects: Falkovnia is altered by Drakov's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Authoritarian Regime
items.entry: Drakov's allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws.

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: Drakov can't close or open the borders of her domain. Falkovnia's borders are usually closed, but they open one week every month starting on the night of the new moon.

items.name: Endless War
items.entry: Whenever a creature other than Drakov or her allies finishes a Long Rest in the domain, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the creature doesn't remove any {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels as a result of finishing that rest, and the creature gains 1 Exhaustion level.

regionalEffects: If Drakov dies, these effects end immediately.

name: White Dragon
regionalEffects: The region containing an adult or ancient white dragon's lair is affected by its presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Frigid Cold
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is an area of {@hazard extreme cold|XDMG}. Any water in that area is {@hazard frigid water|XDMG}. See the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for rules on extreme cold and frigid water.

items.name: Glacial Gloom
entries: The area within 1 mile of the lair is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by chilly fog. Whenever a creature other than the dragon or one of its allies finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in that area, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced by 10 feet for 1 hour.

regionalEffects: If the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

name: Wilfred Godefroy
regionalEffects: Mordent is altered by Lord Godefroy's presence, creating the following effects:

items.name: Closing the Borders
items.entry: While in his domain, Lord Godefroy can close or open the borders to Mordent. While the borders are closed, the groans and whispers of the dead fill the Mists surrounding Mordent. Creatures in the Mists have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Ears Everywhere
items.entry: While in his domain, Lord Godefroy can cast {@spell Sending|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. When casting the spell in this way, Lord Godefroy can target any Undead creature in Mordent, in addition to the usual targets.

items.name: Spectral Serfs
items.entry: A Humanoid that dies in Mordent rises 7 days later as a {@creature Specter|XMM} under Lord Godefroy's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life.

regionalEffects: If Wilfred dies, these effects end immediately.
